hits.title: Switch to AI-adjusted search volume in Brand Radar | Ahrefs posted on the topic | LinkedIn
hits.snippet: 🎯 NEW in Brand Radar: We're switching from Google search volume to AI-adjusted volume for more realistic prompt volume and impression estimates. Each prompt's volume is now its parent keyword's Google volume × a platform ratio, based on how much that platform is used compared to Google. This reflects how the same prompt has different volume per platform. Want the old numbers? A toggle in every report header switches back until August 31, 2026.
